goal: Make Linux non-GUI release binaries run across distributions like Alpine and NixOS without extra shims
Allow release binaries to run on older Linux distributions and enable pointer authentication on aarch64
agreement: Broad support and verified by testing across NixOS, Alpine, Fedora, Arch, and Ubuntu
Unaddressed objection: static glibc binaries break when host dynamic NSS resolvers mismatch (luke-jr)
Approach approval for the static glibc architecture and Guix manifest updates (willcl-ark, hebasto, jsarenik)
Open questions remain on handling fortify security checks on static binaries (willcl-ark)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it allows official Linux release binaries to run on non-glibc and older distributions
Enables aarch64 pointer authentication for release builds
Modifies Guix manifests, glibc patches, and ELF binary security validation scripts
